newsitem.title: UK: Russia largest importer of Cuban sugar in 1996 -IS.
newsitem.headline: Russia largest importer of Cuban sugar in 1996 -IS.

text.p: Russia remained the largest country of destination for Cuban sugar in 1996, more than doubling its imports compared with 1995, the International Sugar Organization (ISO) said on Tuesday.
Russia imported 1.83 million tonnes of Cuban raws last year after 722,051 in 1995, the ISO said.
China took second place in the 1996 league, importing 432,417 tonnes after a previous 683,176 tonnes.
Ukraine imported 175,214 tonnes of Cuban raws after zero imports in 1994 and 1995, the ISO data showed. Canada took 141,446 tonnes after 143,674 tonnes.
Raw sugar exports in January 1997 alone amounted to 272,904 tonnes, slightly down on the 277,310 tonnes exported in January 1996.
Russia and Iran were the two largest importers in January 1997, the ISO said. Iran imported no Cuban sugar in January 1996.
